task: vector_addition concrete mixed integer/bool and fp32 extension
standard: all original declared stages/dtypes/branches; only explicitly registered numerical assumptions may be deferred

software_primitives: FP.round .fp32 cfg of exact integer rational
public_contract.unused_floating_rest: The result formula contains no Algebra callback; the generic rest supplies unreachable operations only.
public_contract.total_contract: Every source bit pattern and masked lane has a totalized logical execution; undefined active conversions retain the explicitly supplied policy.
public_contract.defined_contract: Only active integer-output addresses must satisfy the shared finite toward-zero range specification. Any undefined policy yields the same specified memory.
public_contract.fp32_output_contract: No finiteness or conversion-domain condition is required when x is fp32; the shared FP.add covers exceptional encodings.

numerical_assumptions.detail: One FP.round from the exact integer rational. Signed widths are interpreted with BitVec.toInt, unsigned/bool with BitVec.toNat. Explicit fp32 precision wraps the .real carrier; the final carrier-tag cast is identity and adds no numerical rounding. Native rounding mode/format/representability must be bound.

Source operand order is preserved for both orientations. Native cfg, FTZ/DAZ, rounding and exceptional payload/signaling behavior remain unproved. No commutativity, real exactness or finite-input law is assumed.

numerical_assumptions.primitive: toward-zero fp32 to signed8/16/32/64 or unsigned8/16/32/64
numerical_assumptions.detail: Uses shared exact rational toSigned/toUnsigned, with finite/range domain. Bool destination uses signed8 fptosi, so 3 remains3 and128 is undefined. Arbitrary fallback is exposed; the active defined-domain theorem proves no fallback affects a store. No fixed result is claimed on NaN/Inf/overflow.

structural_remaining.gap: 93 promoted dtype pairs remain without logical value/grid proofs
structural_remaining.detail: 54 mixed fp16/bf16/fp64 pairs,11 supported fp64 float pairs,28 promoted fnuz rejections. Direct int→fp16 must not be modeled with extra fp32 rounding; fp16→integer needs the actual extf→fp32 route.

The18 raw exact-source TTIR graphs are copied from the frozen289-profile audit with matching hashes. No native backend/GPU execution or formal source extraction theorem is supplied. In particular, totalized software execution and masked policy independence do not prove native poison propagation, traps, sanitizer behavior or compiler availability.

structural_remaining.gap: Native storage and finite-width address metadata
structural_remaining.detail: Logical Int/Nat/fp32 cells, own-width integer normalization, bool i8 reinterpretation and Nat offsets require byte/tag/representability refinement. Shape/stride/device/contiguity guards absent from Python were not invented. Physical overlapping views with different bases/widths/strides remain open.

This batch has the complete ascending logical grid with current-memory reads and equal logical region aliases. Native instruction interleaving, allocator/empty_like/device behavior, typed native wrapper dispatch and Python/Torch harness execution retain previous structural gaps.
